rows.descriptionText: Produces 1-4 units of a random rare resource (Mercury, Crystals or Gemstones) at the start of each week.
rows.notes: building pass 2026-11-22: rampart.mystic_pond. Plugin-only banks carrier. At the owner's first day of each week (day 8, 15, ...) every owned Rampart city with this row adds 1-4 (uniform) of one of mercury/crystals/gemstones; paid once per side per week, persisted in the store buff homm3_rampart_income_store (Core row requested in build_crt.md). HoMM3 cost 2000 Gold + 2 each of the rare set (sulfur -> mercury).

rows.descriptionText: At the start of each week, you gain 10% of the Gold you hold.
rows.notes: building pass 2026-11-22: rampart.treasury. Plugin-only banks carrier. At the owner's first day of each week the side gains floor(10% of its gold as it stood before that day's income) per owned Rampart city with this row; uncapped (draft owner decision 1, recommended). Same exactly-once store as the Pond. HoMM3 cost 5000 Gold + 5 Ore.
